nativeRuntime: JavaFX 24.0.1 macOS ES2 with exact no-color-mipmap and centroid-UV compatibility jar
fixtures: Same 48 geometric/color/order/AA cases per setting as original protocol; 288 positive cases total. Existing unlit 256 run must remain byte-identical.
normals: Original vertices receive normalized (0.8*cos(2*pi*x/n), 0.6*sin(2*pi*y/n), 0.35+(x-y)/n), stored as Float. This is an explicit varying shading-normal field on planar geometry, not a geometric-normal reconstruction claim.
oracle: Binary v24 records original RGB, Float normals and Double lighting parameters. Python independently computes clamped Lambert factor and rounds shaded vertex RGB before applying the existing original-triangle pixel oracle. It does not read atlas colors or UVs.
negativeControls: AdaptiveAffineOpaque 4096/Unlit stock must fail dense ramp
limits: Covers atlas width and non-power-of-two dimensions, not all maximum texture areas
No actual device-scale sweep, perspective, cortex occlusion or production packaging
Lighting is baked at vertices in world coordinates; not a native Phong lighting claim
Soft lighting is a QA candidate, not a changed application default
